phrases.def: 普通普通普通从业人员

sentences.en: The first students to study alternative medicine at university level in Australia began their four-year, full-time course at the University of Technology, Sydney, in early 1994.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚大学一级首名学习替代医学的学生于1994年初开始在悉尼技术大学接受四年全时课程。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Their course covered, among other therapies, acupuncture.
sentences.zh: 除其他疗法外,他们的课程包括针灸。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The theory they learnt is based on the traditional Chinese explanation of this ancient healing art: that it can regulate the flow of ‘Qi’ or energy through pathways in the body.
sentences.zh: 以中国传统对古代治疗艺术的解释为基础: 它可以调节身体内能量或能量的流经。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: This course reflects how far some alternative therapies have come in their struggle for acceptance by the medical establishment.
sentences.zh: 课程反映了一些替代疗法在争取医疗机构接受治疗的斗争中取得了多大进展。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Australia has been unusual in the Western world in having a very conservative attitude to natural or alternative therapies, according to Dr Paul Laver, a lecturer in Public Health at the University of Sydney.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚对自然疗法或替代疗法采取非常保守的态度,这在西方世界是不寻常的,悉尼大学公共卫生讲师Paul Laver博士说,这是澳大利亚对自然疗法或替代疗法采取非常保守的态度。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: ‘We’ve had a tradition of doctors being fairly powerful and I guess they are pretty loath to allow any pretenders to their position to come into it.’ In many other industrialized countries, orthodox and alternative medicines have worked ‘hand in glove’ for years.
sentences.zh: `我们有医生相当强大的传统,我想他们非常讨厌让任何假冒者进入他们的位置。 ' 在许多其他工业化国家,正统和替代药物已经“用手套”工作多年。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In Europe, only orthodox doctors can prescribe herbal medicine.
sentences.zh: 在欧洲,只有正统医生才能开药方

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In Germany, plant remedies account for 10% of the national turnover of pharmaceutical.
sentences.zh: 在德国,工厂补救措施占全国药品营业额的10%。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Americans made more visits to alternative therapist than to orthodox doctors in 1990, and each year they spend about $US 12 billion on the therapies that have not been scientifically tested.
sentences.zh: 1990年,美国人去其他治疗师的诊疗次数比东正教医生多,每年他们花费大约120亿美元用于未经科学检验的治疗。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Disenchantment with orthodox medicine has seen the popularity of alternative therapies in Australia climb steadily during the past 20 years.
sentences.zh: 近20年来,澳大利亚替代疗法的普及程度稳步上升,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In a 1983 national health survey, 1.9% of people said they had contacted a chiropractor, naturopath, osteopath, acupuncturist or herbalist in the two weeks prior to the survey.
sentences.zh: 在1983年全国健康调查中,1.9%的人说在调查前两周与一位脊椎按摩师、甲状腺病、骨科病、针刺病或草药师进行了接触。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: By 1990, this figure had risen to 2.6% of the population.
sentences.zh: 到1990年,这一数字已上升到人口的2.6%。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The 550,000 consultations with alternative therapists reported in the 1990 survey represented about an eighth of the total number of consultations with medically qualified personnel covered by the survey, according to Dr Laver and colleagues writing in the Australian Journal of Public Health in 1993.
sentences.zh: 1990年调查中报告的与替代治疗师的55万次咨询,占调查所涉医疗合格人员咨询总数的约八分之一。 据Laver博士和1993年在《澳大利亚公共卫生杂志》上撰写的同事称,这些咨询约占调查所涉医疗合格人员咨询总数的八分之一。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: ‘A better educated and less accepting public has become disillusioned with the experts in general and increasingly skeptical about science and empirically based knowledge,’ they said.
sentences.zh: ”他们说, “一个受过更好教育和接受程度较低的公众对专家普遍感到失望,对科学和经验知识越来越持怀疑态度。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: ‘The high standing of professionals, including doctors, has been eroded as a consequence.’
sentences.zh: 包括医生在内的专业人员的崇高地位因此受到侵蚀。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Rather than resisting or criticizing this trend, increasing numbers of Australian doctors, particularly younger ones, are forming group practices with alternative therapists or taking courses themselves, particularly in acupuncture and herbalism.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的澳大利亚医生,特别是年轻医生,没有抵制或批评这一趋势,反而在另类治疗师中形成集体做法,或自己上课程,特别是在针灸和草药方面。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Part of the incentive was financial, Dr Laver said.
sentences.zh: Laver博士说,部分奖励是财政方面的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: ‘The bottom line is that most general practitioners are business people. If they see potential clientele going elsewhere, they might want to be able to offer a similar service.’
sentences.zh: `底线是,大多数普通医生都是商人。 如果他们看到潜在的客户去其他地方,他们也许想提供类似的服务。 '

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In 1993, Dr Laver and his colleagues published a survey of 289 Sydney people who attended eight alternative therapists’ practices in Sydney.
sentences.zh: 1993年,Laver博士及其同事公布了对参加悉尼八种替代治疗师做法的289名悉尼人的调查。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: These practices offered a wide range of alternative therapies from 25 therapists.
sentences.zh: 这些做法提供了25名治疗师提供的各种替代疗法。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Those surveyed had experience chronic illnesses, for which orthodox medicine had been able to provide little relief.
sentences.zh: 接受调查的人患有慢性病,正统医学无法提供多少救济。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: They commented that they liked the holistic approach of their alternative therapists and the friendly, concerned and detailed attention they had received.
sentences.zh: 他们评论说,他们喜欢替代治疗师采取整体办法,他们得到友好、关心和详细关注。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The cold, impersonal manner of orthodox doctors featured in the survey.
sentences.zh: 调查中出现的冷酷、非人性化的正统医生表现在调查中

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: An increasing exodus from their clinics, coupled with this and a number of other relevant surveys carried out in Australia, all pointing to orthodox doctors’ inadequacies, have led mainstream doctors themselves to begin to admit they could learn from the personal style of alternative therapists.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的人离开诊所,再加上澳大利亚进行的这项调查以及其他一些相关调查,都表明正统医生的不足,导致主流医生自己开始承认他们可以从替代治疗师的个人风格中学习。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Dr Patrick Store, President of the Royal College of General Practitioners, concurs that orthodox doctors could learn a lot about beside manner and advising patients on preventative health from alternative therapists.
sentences.zh: 皇家全科医生学院院长Patrick Store博士同意,正统医生可以学习许多与其他方式相邻的方式,并向病人提供预防性保健咨询。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: According to the Australian Journal of Public Health, 18% of patients visiting alternative therapists do so because they suffer from muscular-skeletal complaints; 12% suffer from digestive problems, which is only 1% more than those suffering from emotional problems.
sentences.zh: 根据《澳大利亚公共卫生杂志》,18%的病人去看替代治疗师,因为他们受到肌肉骨骼方面的抱怨;12%的人患有消化问题,这比那些患有情绪问题的人多1%。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Those suffering from respiratory complaints represent 7% of their patients, and candida sufferers represent an equal percentage.
sentences.zh: 患有呼吸道感染的人占病人的7%,而受感染者占同等比例。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Headache sufferers and those complaining of general ill health represent 6% and 5% of patients respectively, and a further 4% see therapists for general health maintenance.
sentences.zh: 头痛患者和那些抱怨普遍健康状况不佳的人分别占病人的6%和5%,还有4%的人看治疗师进行一般健康维护。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The survey suggested that complementary medicine is probably a better term than alternative medicine.
sentences.zh: 调查表明,补充药物的用词可能比替代药物好。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Alternative medicine appears to be an adjunct, sought in times of disenchantment when conventional medicine seems not to offer the answer.
sentences.zh: 替代药物似乎是一种辅助药物,在常规医学似乎没有提供答案时,在不抱幻想的时候寻求替代药物。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

items.prompt: Traditionally, how have Australian doctors differed from doctors in many Western countries?
Australians have been turning to alternative therapies in increasing numbers over the past 20 years.
Between 1983 and 1990 the numbers of patients visiting alternative therapists rose to include a further 8% of the population.
The 1990 survey related to 550,000 consultations with alternative therapists.
In the past, Australians had a higher opinion, of doctors than they do today.
Some Australian doctors -are retraining in alternative therapies.
Alternative therapists earn higher salaries than doctors.
The 1993 Sydney survey involved 289 patients who visited alternative therapists for acupuncture treatment.
All the patients in the 1993 Sydney survey had long-term medical complaints.
